learnFactions.title: Factions
learnFactions.description: Understanding your faction is crucial for success in the game. Each faction has unique characteristics and abilities.

factions.title: Mechanisms
factions.description: The Mechanisms are a versatile faction, known for their adaptability and resourcefulness. Their focus lies in a balanced approach to offensive and defensive strategies.
factions.sampleAbilityDisc: Causes your Commander to gain 4 armor plates. Each plate blocks portional damage and regenerate over time.
factions.sampleHQDisc: A balance of offense and defense. Timing the output of The Factory is key to success.

factions.title: Void Whisperers
factions.description: The Void Whisperers excel in ground control. Focusing on territorial dominance and key use of strong global abilities, they are formidable opponents in any confrontation.
factions.sampleAbilityDisc: Attacking enemy units can cause rats to spawn. Rats will attack the nearest enemy unit.
factions.sampleHQDisc: The Island is ours. The Void Gate allows for map control and strategic positioning.

factions.title: Inferno Crusade
factions.description: The Inferno Crusade is considered the most aggressive of factions, focusing primarily on offensive capabilities. Their strength lies in overwhelming their opponents with sheer power and relentless attacks.
factions.sampleAbilityDisc: Targeted spells deal additional damage over time.
factions.sampleHQDisc: Pure firepower and strength, The Inferno Forge provides strong offensive capabilities.

factions.title: The Green Order
factions.description: The Green Order is known for their resilience and strategic defense. They excel in fortifying positions and outlasting their opponents.
factions.sampleAbilityDisc: While inside your territory, gain bonus health regeneration.
factions.sampleHQDisc: Just like the dense forest of the Green Order, The Grove is a powerful defensive structure that keeps your territory secure.
